title: Lesson 35 - Connecting an Agent to Channels: Lightning, Messaging, Email, Voice, and Slack
description: Explain the process for connecting agents to various channels such as digital experience, email, voice, and Slack.

questions.question: A team wants its internal staff to work with the agent inside their collaboration tool. Which connection and agent type fit?
options: The messaging connection on a service agent
The service email connection on a service agent
The Slack connection on an Employee agent
The telephony connection on a service agent
questions.explanation: Slack is an employee surface, and the Slack connection attaches to an Agentforce Employee agent, so it is the match for internal collaboration.

questions.question: You add a telephony connection so customers can call the agent. What must the agent support?
options: That it is voice-enabled through Agentforce Voice with a telephony provider selected
That it uses Enhanced Web Chat response formats
That it runs only in the Agentforce panel
questions.explanation: Telephony connections route calls through Agentforce Voice to a voice-enabled agent, which requires selecting a telephony provider rather than any text-channel setup.

questions.question: Which connection routes a customer's inbound email to the agent for an autonomous response?
options: The service email connection, which routes through Email-to-Case
questions.explanation: The service email connection routes through Email-to-Case so the service agent can respond to customer email, unlike the web and collaboration surfaces.
